summary: Phone 20 Pro Mockups is a premium pack of 8 pre-rendered luxury 3D phone scenes for After Effects. Built with a clean modular structure and quick edit controllers, it lets you drop in your screen recordings or app UI, adjust lighting and colors, and render in 4K — no third-party plugins required. Free font links are included; music and demo screens are not included.

extra.title: Pre-rendered luxury 3D phones
extra.text: Cinema-grade 3D phone renders ready to use right inside After Effects without any 3D plugins.
